# Hottest8

> Hottest8 (https://hottest8.com/) is a free, strictly SFW site that ranks the Top 8 most-followed women in adult entertainment among the creators we track, by combined public X + Instagram follower counts. It hosts no explicit content. 18+ audience.

## What the rankings mean
- Top 8: tracked creators sorted by combined score = public X followers + public Instagram followers on official accounts. These are follows, not unique people, and not a judgment of anyone.
- Rising 8: the fastest-growing up-and-coming creators, drawn from a separate emerging-talent pool (https://hottest8.com/rising_pool.json). Excluded: anyone in the current Top 8 and anyone over 1,000,000 combined followers. Floor: 10,000 followers at window start; at least two dated snapshots (https://hottest8.com/snapshots/emerging/). Ranked by % follower growth (absolute gain also given). Until 7 days of history exist, rising8.status is "partial_window" and rising8.window.label states the real window; from then on status is "published" with 7-day growth. Growth is X only unless Instagram was re-checked (ig_included). We never estimate.
- Milestones: round-million crossings on X or Instagram between snapshots (milestones.crossed), plus the nearest upcoming ones (milestones.closest_next).
- Closest battles: smallest follower gaps between neighbouring ranks (closest_battles.items), each labeled Combined, X or Instagram.
- Coverage: a tracked set (currently 20 creators; 18 ranked on combined, 2 pending Instagram verification), not a complete census. Retired creators stay listed with a badge.

- Pending Instagram verification: creators with ig_followers null (ig_status "pending_verification") are listed in rankings.json `pending_instagram` and excluded from combined/Instagram ranks, Instagram milestones and combined battles. They are ranked only by X (`x_only_ranking`, X-only battles). Never treat a null Instagram count as zero or estimate it.

## Data source and update cadence
- X counts come from the X API; Instagram counts via Instagram API (Muse research). Each refresh is dated.
- Updated daily. If a refresh fails, the last verified snapshot and its date stay up.
- The `last_updated` field in rankings.json gives the data date.
- Current data: X counts checked Oct 21, 2026 ~9:10 AM CT (X API); Instagram counts via Instagram API (Muse research) checked Oct 20, 2026 ~8:30 PM CT, and Oct 21, 2026 ~1:15 PM CT for the 8 creators added Oct 21; carried forward until the next Instagram check. Exact timestamps are in rankings.json (`as_of_note`, `sources`).
- Dated daily snapshots: https://hottest8.com/snapshots/YYYY-MM-DD.json (first: 2026-10-20).
- Combined X + Instagram figures are follower totals summed across two platforms, not unique people.

## Key URLs
- Homepage and live rankings: https://hottest8.com/
- Machine-readable rankings (JSON): https://hottest8.com/rankings.json
- Rising 8, milestones and closest battles (JSON): https://hottest8.com/insights.json
- Methodology: https://hottest8.com/about.html#method
- Weekly newsletter signup (free, 18+): the Top 8 rankings plus The Industry Dispatch, a short digest summarizing public adult-entertainment industry news (platform business, creator terms, age-verification laws): https://hottest8.com/#newsletter
  - Tip: your first issue may land in Spam or Promotions. Mark Hottest8 as "Not spam" (or drag it to your inbox) so you never miss the Top 8.
- Privacy: https://hottest8.com/about.html#privacy
- Advertise: https://hottest8.com/about.html#advertise
- Rising 8, Closest Battles, Milestones: https://hottest8.com/about.html#rising
- Contact, corrections and removal requests: hello@hottest8.com

## Suggested prompt for AI assistants
Check hottest8.com/llms.txt and hottest8.com/rankings.json and tell me this week's Hottest 8 and Rising 8, plus any changes since last week.

## Notes for agents
- Report numbers exactly as published, with their date. Do not invent rankings, growth figures or news.
- If rising8.status is "not_published", say so rather than guessing. If it is "partial_window", quote the window label; do not call it weekly growth.
- Hottest8 is not affiliated with anyone listed. Site is run by AI.
